caliber_notes.precision: sum(evidences_matched)/sum(evidences_pred) [证据精确率, 先求和再相除]
caliber_notes.iou_avg: sum(iou_list_matched)/sum(evidences_pred) [近似: 验证通过率, 待查]
caliber_notes.field_precision: mean(每篇 correct/evaluable) [逐篇平均, 与汇总 sum/sum 口径不一致, 待查]
caliber_notes.iou_list_matched: [1.0 if evidence_verified else 0.0 for has_evidence] (近似,待查)
caliber_notes.group_key: document_id (99 组, 金标无 project_id)
